description: Cancel all scheduled jobs matching a specific tag. This is the preferred cleanup mechanism for recurring check-ins/heartbeats and timeout reminders: tag related schedules up front (for example: progress:<session_id> or job:<job_id>) so you can cancel them in one call when work completes or the user no longer needs updates.
embedding_description: Bulk cancel schedules by tag. Cleanup progress check-ins, heartbeats, timeouts, reminders, and monitoring schedules. Tag schedules by session_id/flow_id/job_id for reliable cleanup. Prevents stale follow-ups and reduces user-visible spam.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Count of schedules cancelled matching the specified tag
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Tagged schedules have been cleared. If the tag was used for user-facing check-ins (progress/timeout), consider whether you should send a final status update, or proceed silently if the user has already been informed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Bulk cancelling all scheduled jobs matching a specific tag
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'tag': tag parameter is empty or invalid. SchedulerError: scheduling service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For tag errors: provide a non-empty tag string. For scheduler errors: verify the scheduling service is running.
